Package org.dreambot.api.methods.settings

Class Varcs

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.settings.Varcs
  • public class Varcs
extends java.lang.Object
    Class used to access read/write methods for RS client varc values. Note: This should be used inside of the client thread. See Client.getOnGameThread(Supplier) and Client.runOnGameThread(Runnable)
